_comment: Spatial analysis profiles. EVERY radius and bin edge is declared here, a
priori. Nothing downstream may choose a radius after looking at a curve:
with 12 radius bins and a free choice of r, an uncorrected 'significant'
result is guaranteed. Exactly one radius per profile carries
primary=true; all others are exploratory and must be reported as such.
Bin edges are FIXED so that histograms from different slides and mice are

cell_classes._comment: A class is a predicate over the engine's per-cell columns. 'call' uses <MARKER>_final_call (1 / 0 / '' = indeterminate, IF_Quant_Pipeline.groovy line 2532). 'class_col' uses the engine's compound class column (line 2557). Indeterminate cells are NEVER silently treated as negative: they are excluded from the class AND from the eligible pool, and the exclusion is counted.

ifng_ko_pr8_ectopic_pod.label: IFN-gamma KO + PR8, KRT5 ectopic pod niche (panel LEFT)
ifng_ko_pr8_ectopic_pod._region_comment: The endpoint denominator is DAMAGED alveolar area. Restricting the point pattern to region rows containing 'damaged' keeps the spatial window identical to the endpoint denominator that aggregate_tiles_to_slide.py already uses (its endpoint_rows selection, lines 225-228).
ifng_ko_pr8_ectopic_pod._pool_comment: The random-labelling null permutes the class label among this pool. Change it and you change the null hypothesis; it is therefore declared, not inferred.

structures.name: KRT5pod
structures._source_comment: Written by IF_Quant_Pipeline.groovy line 2782 for every channel with areaMarker:true and areaMode 'pod'. Full-tile binary mask at the tile's own calibration.

fallback._fallback_comment: PROXY ONLY. Discs around KRT5+ nuclei are not the pod area the endpoint measures. Any row produced from the fallback is stamped structure_source=cell_class_dilation_proxy and must not be reported as a pod distance.

window._window_comment: Stage 1 keeps the global tissue mask in memory only (qupath_wsi_tile_export.groovy lines 607-624) and never writes it to disk, so the analysis window is estimated from the nuclei themselves: the union of discs of radius dilate_um around every retained nucleus. Smaller values fragment the window and inflate its boundary; larger values swallow airspace and vessels. 30 um is ~ one alveolar wall spacing. The window area is reconciled against region_area_um2 from run_summary and the ratio is emitted as QC.

ifng_ko_pr8_ectopic_pod._query_comment: Ripley/neighbourhood focal points are subsampled above this count with a fixed seed. K-hat = sum(S) / sum(D) and D is computed from the SUBSAMPLED focal count, so the ratio stays unbiased; only its variance rises. n_query_points and query_subsample_fraction are emitted.
